newsitem.title: USA: Comdisco cash flow backs new business.
newsitem.headline: Comdisco cash flow backs new business.

text.p: Comdisco Inc, a technology services company, said Wednesday its cash flow is expected to be sufficient to allow it to continue to write new leases for equipment and services without significantly increasing its leverage.

"Because of the tremendous cash flow that the company generates, we should be able to continue to fund the record pace of business volume without a significant increase in our leverage," Jack Slevin, chairman, said in a statement. "Our future contractual cash flow is in excess of $5.3 billion."
Earlier, Comdisco reported earnings for the third quarter ended June 30 of $0.40 a share, up from $0.34 a year ago. Sales were up 20 percent to $712 million.
Slevin said Comdisco's European operations and diversified technologies division contributed significantly to the strength of earnings in the quarter.
